description: `ui-health reindex status <job_id>` and `ui-health reindex cancel <job_id>` expose structured progress and termination for long-running reindex jobs.

requirements.description: The CLI command `ui-health reindex status <job_id>` must return structured progress information for a reindex job identified by job_id. The output must include: current state (PENDING/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED), scenarios_total, scenarios_completed, current_scenario (if running), start_time, and estimated completion time or end_time.
requirements.title: Reindex Job Status Query Command

validation.notes: Status command outputs valid JSON with all required fields
State field reflects correct lifecycle state of the job
scenarios_completed increments as scenarios are processed
Unknown job_id returns a structured error response with exit code non-zero
Start a reindex job, poll status mid-run, and confirm scenarios_completed < scenarios_total and state is RUNNING
After reindex completion, query status and confirm state is COMPLETED and scenarios_completed equals scenarios_total
After cancel, query status and confirm state is CANCELLED
Operations teams can monitor and audit reindex job progress in CI pipelines or dashboards

requirements.description: The CLI command `ui-health reindex cancel <job_id>` must terminate a running or pending reindex job gracefully. In-flight Qdrant upserts for the current scenario must complete before the job halts. The job state must transition to CANCELLED and be queryable via the status command.
requirements.title: Reindex Job Cancellation Command

validation.notes: Cancel command sends a cancellation signal to the job identified by job_id
Job state transitions to CANCELLED after cancellation is acknowledged
Cancelling an already-completed job returns a structured error (cannot cancel completed job)
Cancelling an unknown job_id returns a structured error with exit code non-zero
Start a reindex job, issue cancel, and confirm job state becomes CANCELLED within 5 seconds
Confirm that scenarios processed before cancellation remain in Qdrant (partial progress is preserved)
Confirm that cancellation does not leave the Qdrant collection in a corrupt or partially-written state
Cancellation acknowledgment is received within 2 seconds of issuing the cancel command
Operators can abort expensive reindex operations without having to kill processes manually

title: Reindex job lifecycle verbs
